title: Reconstruction Pipeline
subtitle: Operate a synthetic image-to-model reconstruction system
introTitle: Make the reconstruction tell you what the dataset cannot.
introBody: Run the supplied image set through a deterministic reconstruction. Inspect the resulting model, trace its weak area back to the image stations, replace the poor input, and rebuild.
provisional: Developed M3.1 learning material is not yet available. This synthetic dataset and its scoring are provisional.
inputHint: Select or drag an image, then place it at a camera station. A placement swaps the two inputs.
outputIdle: Run the pipeline to generate the first reconstruction.
traceOn: Weak output traced to east image coverage
traceHint: The east surface is fragmented and doubled. Inspect the image station feeding this area.
problemTitle: Output is incomplete and locally ghosted.
problemBody: The visible east hole and duplicate edge make this result unsuitable for the intended review. Change the input constellation and rebuild.
fixedTitle: Output is coherent and complete enough for this scenario.
fixedBody: The east return view fills the missing geometry and removes the soft duplicate from the active set.
reportPass: Reconstruction approved for the fictional review task.
reportPassBody: The input correction produced a visible improvement and the rebuilt output meets this scenario's qualitative fitness gate.
reportFailBody: The visible hole and ghosted edge remain. The dataset or processing input needs another correction before use.
swapHint: Tip: the held east return view covers a different position than the active soft duplicate.
scenarioNote: Deterministic synthetic processing · no real thresholds
